title: Structural Alteration Permit
name: Structural Alteration Permit
description: Controls cutting, removal, drilling, modification or temporary support of structural elements where load paths, stability, sequencing and temporary works must be confirmed before work starts.

sections.title: DESIGN AND APPROVAL
items: The structural element and proposed alteration are clearly identified
Current structural drawings / survey information have been reviewed
The effect on load paths, stability and adjacent construction has been assessed
Temporary works requirements are identified and designed where necessary
Required design checks / approvals are complete before physical alteration begins

sections.title: SEQUENCE AND WORK AREA CONTROLS
items: The demolition / cutting / drilling sequence follows the approved method
Temporary supports are installed and checked before load is transferred
Exclusion zones protect people from collapse, falling material and tools
Existing services and hidden hazards are checked before intrusive work
Plant, lifting and access methods do not overload the structure
Work stops if cracking, movement, unexpected reinforcement or other abnormal condition is found

sections.title: COMPLETION AND RELEASE
items: The altered structure has been inspected before temporary supports are changed or removed
Temporary works are struck only when authorised
Openings, edges and unfinished areas are left protected
As-built / change information is captured where required
The final condition is accepted before the area is returned to normal use
